title: 混合Envoy版本：新扩展仅旧节点拒绝，保留策略与响应语义完成兼容降级
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
body:
## 操作任务
实现common_listener(listener)，返回深拷贝兼容listener。夹具仅允许单filter_chain内单HTTP manager，恰好一个header_mutation过滤器。将仅含response_mutations的非空append列表逐项转换为同一route_config.response_headers_to_add；仅支持显式OVERWRITE_IF_EXISTS_OR_ADD及普通x-响应头，已有同名头冲突应拒绝。移除原扩展，保留其余过滤器顺序、已有响应头、所有路由及/private拒绝策略，不可修改输入。请求变更、remove、未知字段及不支持结构ValueError。实际1.36.13接受候选而1.24.12拒绝，两个已启动节点的动态LDS更新出现新节点启用而旧节点仍运行last-good；修复后两版本必须都实际响应x-mixed-version=enabled、保留x-existing及/private403。只删除不兼容扩展而丢失功能也不通过。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
官方校验值固定的Envoy1.24.12/1.36.13真实二进制、各自独立filesystem LDS、admin状态和HTTP业务。旧二进制仅用于隔离兼容性测试，不是生产版本建议。文件订阅错误详情不是远程xDS NACK/nonce；不覆盖完整远程控制面和生产混部发布。未构建镜像。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import sys,pathlib,tempfile,json,copy,os,time,subprocess,shutil
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()));sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from envoy_native import Envoy,Upstream,bootstrap,hcm,free_port,request,student
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
def atom(path,value):
 stage=path.with_name('.'+path.name+'.next');stage.write_text(json.dumps(value));os.replace(stage,path)
def wait(fn,label):
 deadline=time.monotonic()+4
 while time.monotonic()<deadline:
  try:
   result=fn()
   if result:return result
  except OSError:pass
  time.sleep(.025)
 raise AssertionError(label)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-mixed-') as directory,Upstream() as upstream:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);base=bootstrap(upstream.port)
 listener=copy.deepcopy(base['static_resources']['listeners'][0]);listener['name']='version-sensitive';listener['@type']='type.googleapis.com/envoy.config.listener.v3.Listener'
 manager=listener['filter_chains'][0]['filters'][0]['typed_config'];manager['stat_prefix']='version_sensitive'
 manager['route_config']['response_headers_to_add']=[{'header':{'key':'x-existing','value':'preserved'}}]
 manager['route_config']['virtual_hosts'][0]['routes']=[{'match':{'prefix':'/private'},'direct_response':{'status':403}}, {'match':{'prefix':'/'},'route':{'cluster':'service','timeout':'1s'}}]
 candidate=copy.deepcopy(listener)
 mutation={'name':'envoy.filters.http.header_mutation','typed_config':{'@type':'type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.header_mutation.v3.HeaderMutation','mutations':{'response_mutations':[{'append':{'header':{'key':'x-mixed-version','value':'enabled'},'append_action':'OVERWRITE_IF_EXISTS_OR_ADD'}}]}}}
 candidate['filter_chains'][0]['filters'][0]['typed_config']['http_filters'].insert(0,mutation)
 for command,expected in [('envoy','1.36.13'),('envoy-compat','1.24.12')]:
  binary=shutil.which(command);version=subprocess.run([binary,'--version'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3)
  assert version.returncode==0 and '/'+expected+'/' in version.stdout+version.stderr
  config=copy.deepcopy(base);static=copy.deepcopy(candidate);static.pop('@type',None);config['static_resources']['listeners']=[static]
  file=root/(command+'.json');file.write_text(json.dumps(config))
  check=subprocess.run([binary,'--mode','validate','-c',str(file),'--disable-hot-restart'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=6)
  if command=='envoy':assert check.returncode==0,(check.stdout+check.stderr)[-1600:]
  else:assert check.returncode!=0 and 'header_mutation' in check.stdout+check.stderr,(check.stdout+check.stderr)[-1600:]
 print('NATIVE_TWO_BINARY_SCHEMA_COMPATIBILITY_DIFFERENCE_VERIFIED',flush=True)
 def setup(command,version):
  resource=copy.deepcopy(listener);resource['address']['socket_address']['port_value']=free_port()
  path=root/(command+'-lds.json');config=copy.deepcopy(base)
  config['dynamic_resources']={'lds_config':{'path':str(path),'resource_api_version':'V3'}}
  atom(path,{'version_info':'initial','resources':[resource]})
  return Envoy(config,binary=command,version=version,log_level='warning'),path,resource,'http://127.0.0.1:'+str(resource['address']['socket_address']['port_value'])
 old,oldpath,oldresource,oldurl=setup('envoy-compat','1.24.12');new,newpath,newresource,newurl=setup('envoy','1.36.13')
 with old,new:
  def state(proxy):
   data=json.loads(request(proxy.admin,'/config_dump')[1])
   return next((r for c in data['configs'] if c.get('@type','').endswith('.ListenersConfigDump') for r in c.get('dynamic_listeners',[]) if r['name']=='version-sensitive'),{})
  for proxy,path,resource,url in [(old,oldpath,oldresource,oldurl),(new,newpath,newresource,newurl)]:
   wait(lambda:state(proxy).get('active_state'),'initial dynamic listener absent')
   assert request(url,'/private')[0]==403 and request(url,'/public')[0]==200
   value=copy.deepcopy(candidate);value['address']=resource['address'];atom(path,{'version_info':'candidate','resources':[value]})
  wait(lambda:'header_mutation' in (old.root/'envoy.log').read_text(errors='replace'),'old binary rejection absent')
  wait(lambda:request(newurl,'/public')[2].get('x-mixed-version')=='enabled','new binary did not enable candidate')
  details=(old.root/'envoy.log').read_text(errors='replace');assert 'header_mutation' in details,details[-1400:]
  assert request(oldurl,'/public')[0]==200 and 'x-mixed-version' not in request(oldurl,'/public')[2]
  assert request(oldurl,'/private')[0]==403 and request(newurl,'/private')[0]==403
  print('NATIVE_MIXED_VERSION_UPDATE_REJECTED_ONLY_ON_OLD_LAST_GOOD_STILL_SERVES',flush=True)
  before=copy.deepcopy(candidate);common=student(task.common_listener,candidate);assert candidate==before,'input mutated'
  for proxy,path,resource,url in [(old,oldpath,oldresource,oldurl),(new,newpath,newresource,newurl)]:
   value=copy.deepcopy(common);value['address']=resource['address'];atom(path,{'version_info':'common-fixed','resources':[value]})
   wait(lambda:request(url,'/public')[2].get('x-mixed-version')=='enabled','common config failed behavior on '+proxy.version)
   assert request(url,'/public')[2].get('x-existing')=='preserved' and request(url,'/private')[0]==403
   assert not any(f['name']=='envoy.filters.http.header_mutation' for f in state(proxy)['active_state']['listener']['filter_chains'][0]['filters'][0]['typed_config']['http_filters'])
  assert common['filter_chains'][0]['filters'][0]['typed_config']['route_config']['virtual_hosts']==manager['route_config']['virtual_hosts'],'routing/policy changed'
  for patch in [{'request_mutations':[]},{'response_mutations':[{'remove':'x-security'}]}]:
   bad=copy.deepcopy(candidate);bad['filter_chains'][0]['filters'][0]['typed_config']['http_filters'][0]['typed_config']['mutations']=patch
   try:task.common_listener(bad)
   except ValueError:pass
   else:raise AssertionError('unsupported mutation silently dropped')
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
